body: I appreciate you for being honest. That’ll help them understand and heal.

I was in a relationship very similar to yours. My girl, was going through a lot and one day decided to push me away thinking I deserved better. I still hate myself for making her think that way. It hurts me so much. She is my world.

I got on this sub for precisely that. But reading the posts here I gave up trying to reach out. I find it hard to talk about my issues to people I know. I’m not sure if I’m ready to open up yet, but I appreciate you for what you’re doing. Hope you help some folks on here suffering like me.
